comparison.objective: Candidate separates dry finishing media from metal washers; PR snaps a lid completely onto a full paper cup without tipping or squeezing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests orientation-dependent granular passage and bounded agitation; PR tests distributed rim alignment and sequential force application on a fragile, tip-prone container.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% recovery, all washers retained, no spill/damage, and released support dwell; PR requires all eight lid sectors seated, cup/lid pose limits, no tip or wall compression, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Selective screening of many free bodies does not test compliant rim closure or fragile-container stabilization; no comparison-critical rubric detail is absent.
